claude.sample_unit: breast cancer patient profiles (paired scenarios differing in radiotherapy regimen)

links.outcome: LLM side-effect list sensitivity to minor documentation changes in paired scenarios
links.effect: Across models, LLM outputs were sensitive to minor documentation changes, with precision-recall trade-offs and systematic under-recall of rare and long-term side effects.
links.quote: Across models, we reveal sensitivity to minor documentation changes, trade-offs between precision and recall, and systematic under-recall of rare and long-term side effects.

links.outcome: Reliability and robustness of LLM side effect lists with grounding in clinician-curated lists
links.effect: Grounding outputs in clinician-curated side effect lists substantially improved reliability and robustness; numeric constraints alone reduced precision (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: When used alone, constraints on the number of side effects generated reduce precision, and grounding outputs in clinician-curated side effect lists substantially improves reliability and robustness.
